packages.name: Goa
route: North Goa • South Goa • Old Goa • Dudhsagar
packages.description: Enjoy a memorable 5-day Goa escape blending sun-kissed North Goa beaches, historic forts, Old Goa’s heritage, Panjim’s colourful charm, a magical Mandovi sunset cruise, and the natural beauty of Dudhsagar Waterfalls. Relax in luxury, savour scenic sunsets and return home with beautiful Goa memories.
highlights: • Luxury Goa stay with private airport/railway transfers
• North Goa beaches: Calangute, Baga, Anjuna & Vagator
• Fort Aguada and Chapora Fort sightseeing
• Old Goa churches, Panjim & Fontainhas Latin Quarter
• Dudhsagar Waterfalls and Spice Plantation visit
• Leisure time, shopping and unforgettable sunsets

packages.name: Himachal Pradesh
packages.tagline: Elevate Your Senses in the Himalayas.
route: Chandigarh → Shimla → Kufri → Manali → Solang Valley → Atal Tunnel → Sissu → Chandigarh
packages.description: A memorable 6-day Himalayan getaway from Chandigarh, covering the charm of Shimla, Kufri, Manali, Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel and Sissu. Enjoy scenic drives, famous temples, local sightseeing, snow experiences and leisure time in the hills.
